title: Opening frame

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Establish a clear opening hierarchy so a viewer can recognize the subject before the video develops.
strategic_value: A repeated Bold title treatment can connect varied Helsinki subjects through a familiar opening.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture compares four static opening frames: centered and upper-left text on flat color and photographic backgrounds.
practical_value: Choose alignment and text color to suit the background while keeping the title inside the protected area.

content_islands.name: Opening rule
content_islands.spec: Place protected-area, contrast and Bold-font guidance first.

content_islands.name: Four template comparisons
content_islands.spec: Stack each title-frame image beside its alignment, size and line-spacing explanation.

ingredient.name: Opening title
ingredient.application: Use Helsinki Grotesk Bold, centered or upper-left within the safe area; choose white or a palette color for the background.
ingredient.scope: Opening frames. The adjacent templates use 400 px type and 400 px line spacing; these are template values.

reference_purposes.Application: Four templates compare centered and upper-left titles on color and image backgrounds.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The opening uses Helsinki Grotesk Bold and stays within the protected area.
reference_purposes.Expression: Blue, pink and photographic backgrounds show different title treatments.
